en.p: Bag $\mathrm{A}$ contains 3 balls labeled 1, 2, 3, and bag $\mathrm{B}$ contains 4 balls labeled 1, 2, 3, 4. Using the two bags $\mathrm{A}$, $\mathrm{B}$ and one die, the following trial is performed.

box: If the number rolled is a multiple of 3, draw 2 balls at random at the same time from bag $\mathrm{A}$;
if it is not a multiple of 3, draw 2 balls at random at the same time from bag $\mathrm{B}$.
Record the difference of the numbers on the 2 drawn balls, then put the 2 balls back into the bag they came from.

en.p: This trial is repeated 2 times; let $\overline{X}$ be the mean of the two recorded numbers. What is the value of $\mathrm{P}\left(\overline{X}=2\right)$? [4 points]
